mentions.name: Only-EU
mentions.description: A directory of European software and general alternatives to popular products, covering areas like cloud storage, email, VPNs, browsers, smartphones and bikes, with about 175 products across 30+ categories. Upcoming categories include personal health and commercial e-mail/newsletter management, and visitors can suggest missing products via a form on the site.
